name: Diamond Medical Equipment & Supply
old_description: As one of the area’s largest retail suppliers of healthcare products and services, we provide superior customer service and top quality, state-of-the-art home medical equipment and supplies. We take extra care in making sure that we fulfill the needs of each and every one of our customers.
about:
Diamond Medical Equipment & Supply operates from a showroom at 300 South Rodney Parham in Little Rock, Arkansas. The company has served the Central Arkansas region for over four decades, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not stated in available sources.

The business functions as a retail supplier of home medical equipment and supplies, carrying products from manufacturers such as Pride Mobility and Golden Technology. Its showroom — described as the largest in Arkansas — stocks mobility devices including power chairs, scooters, and lift chairs, alongside daily living aids. The company also offers equipment rentals, repair and parts services, and white-glove delivery that includes setup and tutorial within Central Arkansas.

Customers include individuals, caretakers, medical professionals, nursing homes, and assisted living facilities. Diamond Medical bills Medicaid, all PASSE programs, and major medical insurance plans directly, and provides flexible payment options for items not covered by insurance.

The company emphasizes personal service — calls are answered by staff rather than automated systems, with after-hours support available — and highlights its four-decade track record and expansive showroom as reasons customers choose them.
